default risk config ships in PAPER mode
unsupported segment throws instead of inventing a rate

mutating request is allowed from a direct connection only when local trust is asserted
checks.detail: fail-closed without assertion; allowed with OMNI_LOCAL_TRUST=true

checks.name: configured token is required and compared exactly
rate limiter returns 429 once the budget is exhausted

vault uses a per-install random key, not a published constant
checks.detail: 64-hex per-install key, 0600, stable, no constant fallback

checks.name: no user-facing text claims a credential fallback key exists

checks.detail: throws without key, rejects short keys, derives 32 bytes with a key

limitations: The engine's order path itself requires a database and live feed; its LIVE rejection is covered by the existing comprehensive suite and by the interlock constant checked here, not re-exercised end-to-end in this script.
WebSocket stream authentication and vault TOTP are covered by tests/ and were not re-driven here.
Credential material remains in git history: rotation is required and cannot be performed from this environment.
